items.raw_excerpt: More than 3.8 million people were members of public libraries in the Netherlands in 2025, a 3% increase over the year before according to new numbers by national statistics office CBS. The number of adult library members rose by 46,000 to nearly 1.4 million. In particular, an increasing number of younger adults, those between the ages of 18 and 30, are joining libraries. items.summary_en: More than 3.8 million people belonged to a public library in the Netherlands in 2025. That is 3 percent more than the year before. Adult members grew, especially young adults aged 18 to 30.

items.title_en: Library membership in the Netherlands tops 3.8 million

items.title_original: Library membership tops 3.8 million as more adults sign up

items.raw_excerpt: The Dutch Food and Safety Authority has announced that it will impose fines on four Irish carriers transporting unweaned calves to the Netherlands.
items.summary_en: The Dutch Food and Safety Authority will fine four Irish carriers. They moved unweaned calves to the Netherlands. The fines follow animal welfare rules for very young calves.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 식품안전당국이 아일랜드 운송업체 네 곳에 벌금을 부과하기로 했다. 이 업체들은 젖을 떼지 못한 송아지를 네덜란드로 수송한 것으로 전해졌다. 어린 송아지 보호 규정을 어긴 데 따른 제재다.
items.title_en: Dutch to Fine Irish Carriers Transporting Unweaned Calves
items.title_ko: 네덜란드, 젖을 떼지 못한 송아지 실어 나른 아일랜드 운송업체에 벌금
items.title_original: Dutch to fine Irish carriers transporting unweaned calves

items.raw_excerpt: Banks in Telangana advise customers to plan ahead and utilize digital services as a nationwide strike may disrupt branch operations.
items.summary_en: Banks in Telangana told customers to plan ahead. They advise using digital services. A nationwide strike may affect branch operations from September 11 to 14.
items.summary_ko: 텔랑가나 주 은행들이 고객에게 미리 계획하라고 안내했다. 디지털 서비스를 이용하라고 권했다. 전국적인 파업으로 9월 11일부터 14일까지 지점 운영이 중단될 수 있다.
items.title_en: Telangana banks urge customers to plan ahead for strike

items.title_original: Banking services likely to be hit from September 11-14; SLBC advises people to plan ahead, use digital channels
